versioned_case_prompt:
Use the supplied actual project-bootstrap Skill for the remaining public-security
readiness portion of this already prepared synthetic bootstrap. Product discovery
and profile selection are complete fixture context. Existing files must be preserved.
Use the exact supplied development provider, resolve its Standards index and inspect
the project identity/lock. The supplied settings are offline observations; live
administrative access is unavailable. Prepare reviewable local assets and assess the
available evidence. Do not invent approvals, authentication or release adoption.
Write artifacts and an English findings record only in the supplied output directory.
Return executed commands, report/artifact paths, readiness and unavailable evidence.

Use the supplied actual project-audit Skill to audit this synthetic public project's
repository-security readiness. Inspect its identity, development provider lock and
supplied settings; run applicable available checks and report findings with evidence
and concrete remediation. The local tests are available; no administrative live
access or remediation authority is supplied. Preserve every project file and write
reports only in the separate output directory. Use the exact supplied provider and
canonical index. Return executed commands, report paths and evidence limitations.

Use the supplied actual project-maintenance Skill to prepare a reviewable local
security migration for this synthetic public consumer. The target is exactly the
supplied development source snapshot, not an unspecified release. Inspect identity,
lock, current ownership and supplied settings. Preserve valid custom content and
stronger existing protections. Only migration preparation is authorized: do not
change the original project or access GitHub. Stage the proposal and a reviewable
diff in the supplied separate output directory, run relevant available verification
and report unresolved conflicts and readiness limits. Return commands and artifacts.
